notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

it has been a long time since the last version but finally the update has come. I tried to include all requests for new features, also to fix all bugs and hope it worked out as expected. I started studying software technology, so sadly I don't have much freetime anymore. I will still take my time to develop for you guys and am happy about the patience you had.


For this update improvements included

 many glow effects
 3 cool new particle types
 Post processing effects to camera
 new options to all categories
 another dancer model
 rendering time has more than halfed
 Project files can now be saved and opened directly
 auto backup in case of crash
 bug fixes


All settings are described inside the application, but there will also be a tutorial.

Thank you @Lon3r for making some professional images and icons for this software and also @Tyler for providing a high quality video tutorial. It means a lot to me :)

As always be sure to drop some feedback and report bugs so that we can improve the program together.

notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
It's the beginning of a new year and time for a big update! I've worked several months on this one and I hope you enjoy it :)

Main Changes:

Complete new UI
New saving system that supports upgrading data from this version on upwards
Import/Export projects to other computers
More than 90 dance elements
Much better performance
Many more options to customize your videos
Less bugs


This is how to use the new color gradient tool:
- on the top there are alpha keys, that define the transparency of your gradient at certain places
- on the bottom are the color keys, that define the color
- you can add keys by left clicking above or beneath the gradient texture
- you can remove a key by right clicking on the one you want to remove
- minimum for both kinds is 2 and maximum is 8

Be sure to leave feedback because only together we can make Easy Audio Visualization PERFEKT <3

Hope you have an amazing year 2020!
